structured_output.title: Certificate IP address handling behavior change in v1.18.0
structured_output.content: This environment uses cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate resources. The v1.18.0 fix changes how cert-manager handles IP addresses in certificate commonName fields—they are now added to the ipAddresses field instead of DNS subjectAlternativeName. Inspect your Certificate manifests to check if any include IP addresses in the commonName field; if so, verify the certificates issued after upgrade place those IPs in ipAddresses as expected.
